    Registration

    We encourage in-person participation in the Conference.

    We will also have a track, transmitting live keynotes, tutorials, and some sessions, with recordings.

    Travel and health considerations may prevent in-person attendance. Authors with such restrictions must email the registration chairs with details for approval for a presentation of their paper.

    Online non-authors can register without special approval.

    Registration fee information will be updated shortly.
